statements.status_notes: GStreamer security advisory SA-2026-0082 addresses a NULL pointer dereference in gst_rtsp_message_parse_auth_credentials() when parsing Digest Authorization or WWW-Authenticate headers. The fix bounds whitespace parsing within each auth-param token so g_strndup() cannot underflow and decode_quoted_string() is not called on a NULL value. See https://gstreamer.freedesktop.org/security/sa-2026-0082.html and https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/gstreamer/gstreamer-security/-/merge_requests/120.

Debian DSA-6489-1 (gst-plugins-base1.0 1.26.2-1+deb13u2) includes the opusdec >64-channels guard for CVE-2026-18297 in the 1.26.2-1+deb13u2 debian.tar.xz. See https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-18297 and https://gstreamer.freedesktop.org/security/sa-2026-0053.html.
